OPERATION
  Set AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES from 10 to 60 in production payments.conf (PaymentsService).
  Review needed because: production.

WHY
  Production authorization holds expire after 10 minutes before the 15-minute capture delay, causing E4021; restore the documented 60-minute default so holds exceed the capture delay.
  Claim: E4021 means the authorization hold expired before capture; handling requires re-authorization followed by capture, not retrying capture alone.
    source lookup_error_code('E4021') (confidence high, coverage complete, changed 2026-11-04T02:09Z)
    the source returns: E4021: Payment authorization expired / Cause: The authorization hold lapsed before capture. / Handling: Re-authorize, then capture. Do not retry capture alone.
  Claim: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES defaults to 60 and must exceed CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES to prevent authorization holds lapsing before capture.
    source get_config_schema('payments') (confidence high, coverage complete, changed 2026-11-04T02:09Z)
    the source returns: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES integer False 60 Minutes the provider holds an authorization. Must exceed CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES or holds lapse before capture.
  Claim: Production payments has AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES=10 and CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES=15.
    source read_config('production', 'payments') (confidence high, coverage complete, changed 2026-11-06T03:45Z)
    the source returns: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES=10
  Claim: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES configures how long RenewalsWorker holds a renewal authorization before capture.
    source trace_configuration('AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES') (confidence high, coverage complete, changed 2026-11-06T01:29Z)
    the source returns: RenewalsWorker: It is configured by AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES, which sets how long a renewal authorization is held before capture.

AFFECTS
  RenewalsWorker: It is configured by AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES, which sets how long a renewal authorization is held before capture.

  SearchService via SearchService -DEPENDS_ON-> OrderService then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  ApiGateway via ApiGateway -CALLS-> OrdersAPI (exposed by OrderService) then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
